test out all of the colours to try and gage which is giving the higher amounts. Memorise which 2 colours that is and as the amounts start to deplete consider trying the other colour and the likelihood is that the other colour will be giving out more. 
Sometimes one colour may give out 0 and the other may only give 1, it is always better to get a point than none at all and the likelihood is after the 1 that it will rise again on that colour. 
When the amounts do begin to drop lower try experimenting with the other colour and its likely that you will break even on the points amount so there should not be much of a loss.
Trust your intuition and go for the colours you're most drawn to the likelihood is you're right.
